For 0<Delta<b^2, Routh-Hurwitz yields sink and index-one saddle. All hypotheses and exceptional exponential trajectories are explicit.

value.rationale: The negative-forcing saddle-node in a canonical low-degree chaotic-flow family is a natural global boundary problem: a simple local equilibrium fold need not forbid other compact recurrent dynamics, whereas the exact monotone observable does. At equality the theorem settles all bounded forward trajectories and determines the precise universal, model-dependent logarithmic correction, separating exponential and algebraic relaxation. This combination is more than the generic local saddle-node or an equilibrium-only computation.
